bea-ask.speaker: bea
bea-ask.text: Bzzz! Hello! I'm Bea, the baker bee. I'm baking a cake, but I need my ingredients. Here is my recipe: three strawberries, two lemons, and one egg. Exactly that, please!

bea-hint.speaker: narrator
bea-hint.text: Look at the recipe card at the top of the screen. Bring Bea exactly what it says!

bea-progress.speaker: bea
bea-progress.text: Bzzz, lovely! Check the recipe card. What else do we need?

bea-thanks.speaker: bea
bea-thanks.text: Exactly right! You read my recipe perfectly. Bzzz! Now let me teach you a little bee trick.

power-shrink.speaker: narrator
power-shrink.text: Bea taught you to Shrink! Press down at a shrink mushroom to become tiny. Tiny alicorns fit through little tunnels, but tiny wings can only hop. Press down where there's room to grow big again.

millie-ask.speaker: millie
millie-ask.text: Squeak! I'm Millie. I dropped my three sugar buttons in the tunnels. Can you find them? You'll have to be tiny!

millie-hint.speaker: narrator
millie-hint.text: Plan your path! Shrink to fit through the tunnels, and grow big again to fly up high.

millie-progress.speaker: millie
millie-progress.text: Squeak! You found some! The tunnels go deep, so keep going.

millie-thanks.speaker: millie
millie-thanks.text: My sugar buttons! You are a wonderful tunnel explorer. Squeak!

duck-ask.speaker: duck
duck-ask.text: Quack! I'm Duck, the chocolatier. My cocoa beans are behind the cocoa door, but I lost the big spoon that opens it. Can you help?

duck-hint.speaker: narrator
duck-hint.text: First find the spoon. Then open the cocoa door. Then bring Duck three cocoa beans.

duck-progress.speaker: duck
duck-progress.text: Quack quack! Yummy cocoa beans! Are there more?

duck-thanks.speaker: duck
duck-thanks.text: Three cocoa beans! Now I can make the best chocolate in the valley. Thank you!

door-needs-spoon.speaker: narrator
door-needs-spoon.text: The cocoa door has a spoon-shaped lock. Duck's big spoon must be somewhere nearby!

fluff-ask.speaker: fluff
fluff-ask.text: Baa! I'm Fluff. The wind blew my five wool puffs all over the clouds. Will you find them for me?

fluff-progress.speaker: fluff
fluff-progress.text: Baa! So soft! More wool, please!

fluff-thanks.speaker: fluff
fluff-thanks.text: All five wool puffs! Thank you! Now let me teach you my favorite fizzy trick!

power-fizz.speaker: narrator
power-fizz.text: Fluff taught you Fizz Pop! Stand under candy glass and press down to pop right through it.

sweets-note-1.speaker: sol
sweets-note-1.text: Hi! I'm Sol, Pip's little brother. I tumbled into this sweet valley, and my light broke into four sugar sparkles. Can you find them? From, S.

sweets-note-2.speaker: sol
sweets-note-2.text: One sparkle of me is deep in the gumdrop tunnels. You'll have to be tiny to reach it! From, S.

sweets-note-3.speaker: sol
sweets-note-3.text: Duck's river is warm and chocolatey. One sparkle of me floats past the cocoa door. From, S.

sweets-note-4.speaker: sol
sweets-note-4.text: My last sparkle is way up high, behind candy glass in the clouds. Fluff knows a fizzy way in! From, S.

sweets-altar-0.speaker: narrator
sweets-altar-0.text: The candy altar is waiting for Sol's four sugar sparkles.

sweets-altar-1.speaker: narrator
sweets-altar-1.text: One sparkle is home. Three more to find!

sweets-altar-2.speaker: narrator
sweets-altar-2.text: Two sparkles are home. Two more to find!

sweets-altar-3.speaker: narrator
sweets-altar-3.text: Three sparkles are home. Just one more!

sweets-altar-finale.speaker: narrator
sweets-altar-finale.text: Sol shines again! Pip's little brother is back in the sky. You did it!

sweets-altar-done.speaker: narrator
sweets-altar-done.text: Sol twinkles happily over the valley.

pip-sol.speaker: pip
pip-sol.text: Luma is home! And I can feel my little brother Sol. He's somewhere in Sweet Treat Valley. Can you find him?

bea-favor-ask.speaker: bea
bea-favor-ask.text: I baked cupcakes for everyone! Can you help me count them?

fluff-favor-ask.speaker: fluff
fluff-favor-ask.text: Brrr, it's chilly down here. I wish I had a mug of hot cocoa. Millie knows Duck's secret recipe!

millie-favor-ask.speaker: millie
millie-favor-ask.text: I'll make hot cocoa for Fluff if you answer my riddle! Squeak!

millie-riddle.speaker: millie
millie-riddle.text: I am warm and sweet. You sip me from a mug on a cold day. What am I?

millie-favor-give.speaker: millie
millie-favor-give.text: Yes! Here is a mug of hot cocoa. Take it to Fluff!

fluff-favor-wait.speaker: fluff
fluff-favor-wait.text: Baa... is the hot cocoa ready yet?

fluff-favor-thanks.speaker: fluff
fluff-favor-thanks.text: Mmm, hot cocoa! I'm warm and cozy now. Thank you!
